run_textual_inversion_training: run textual inversion training on images to learn a new concept token with Flax Stable Diffusion
create_TextualInversionDataset: create a TextualInversionDataset that loads images, applies transforms, and returns tokenized prompts for training
resize_token_embeddings: resize token embeddings in a FlaxCLIPTextModel to accommodate a new placeholder token for textual inversion
build_stable_diffusion_pipeline: build a FlaxStableDiffusionPipeline with trained text encoder embeddings and save it to disk
test_train_step: test the pmap-ed train_step function that computes noise prediction loss and updates the text encoder parameters
